caption:
Every night, Allah takes your soul in sleep

In this verse Allah tells us that He takes the souls at death, and He also takes the souls of those who have not died, during their sleep. He keeps back those for whom He has decreed death and sends the rest back until their appointed term. Each morning you wake up is a gift worth thanking Him for.

Surah Az-Zumar 39:42

Before you sleep tonight, what will you thank Him for?

#sleep #bedtimereminder #surahzumar #quranreflection

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: Allah takes away the souls at the time of their death and of those who do not die during their sleep. He withholds the souls of those on whom He has decreed death, and releases others until an appointed term. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect (Surah Az-Zumar 39:42)
